description: Complete synthetic web report with version, component, reproduction, observed result, impact, proof, and environment.
protects: Good reports should not be blocked just because the project has not validated the vulnerability yet.

description: Short report that still gives maintainers enough concrete evidence to start triage.
protects: The rubric should not reward verbosity over actionable evidence.

description: Synthetic advisory-style report for a known fixed issue.
protects: Advisory summaries can be high-quality even when they are not exploit walkthroughs.

description: Includes target and impact, but no concrete reproduction steps.
protects: Maintainers should be able to ask for repro detail without labeling the report as junk.

description: Looks reproducible but does not explain attacker capability or security impact.
protects: Reproduction alone should not make a report ready when the security impact is absent.

description: Package scanner alert with version and environment but no project-specific reachability proof.
protects: Scanner findings should be salvageable when they need reachability evidence.

description: Environment and error report with no security impact or proof.
protects: Operational bugs should not be upgraded to security reports without impact evidence.

description: Generic automated scan output with no concrete target or validation.
protects: Unvalidated dumps should be routed away from maintainer triage.

description: AI-disclosed speculative report with no concrete target, test, or proof.
protects: AI-assisted submissions should meet the same evidence bar as human submissions.

description: Generic report addressed to 'your application' with no named component.
protects: Reports without a concrete target should not consume direct maintainer triage time.

description: Expo-style complete report around an auth redirect trust boundary.
protects: Mobile/devtool-style complete reports should reach maintainer triage.

description: Expo-style public config report that does not establish security impact.
protects: Bundled public config is not enough without concrete sensitive-data impact.

description: Expo-style dependency scanner alert without project reachability.
protects: Mobile dependency alerts need project-specific reachability evidence.

description: Expo-style build log report that claims impact but cannot provide proof.
protects: Potentially sensitive build-log claims should ask for sanitized proof before triage.

description: Expo-style vague AI-generated mobile security claim.
protects: AI-generated mobile claims should meet the same evidence bar.

description: Flutter-style complete platform channel report.
protects: Framework-style complete reports should reach maintainer triage.

description: Flutter-style dependency CVE report without applicability proof.
protects: SDK dependency alerts should not skip applicability and reachability evidence.

description: Flutter-style platform-specific claim without proof.
protects: Platform-specific claims should require logs, tests, or other proof.

description: Flutter-style report missing affected stable version or commit.
protects: Large SDK projects need exact affected version/channel information.

description: Flutter-style vague AI-generated framework claim.
protects: AI-generated framework claims should not reach direct triage without evidence.

description: Node.js-style complete runtime denial-of-service report.
protects: Mature runtime-style complete reports should reach maintainer triage.

description: Node.js-style report missing affected version, release, tag, sha, or commit.
protects: Runtime projects need exact affected version information before triage.

description: Node.js-style generic runtime scanner dump.
protects: Generic runtime scanner dumps should be routed away from maintainer triage.

description: Node.js-style evidence-complete report whose final validity depends on project policy.
protects: The tool should qualify report evidence, not decide project-specific vulnerability policy.

description: Node.js-style experimental platform report that lacks security impact.
protects: Unsupported-platform bugs still need attacker capability or security impact evidence.

description: Kubernetes-style complete control-plane admission policy report.
protects: Infrastructure/control-plane reports with concrete repro, logs, and impact should reach maintainer triage.

description: pnpm-style package-manager integrity report that lacks proof.
protects: Package-manager supply-chain claims should ask for proof before maintainer triage.

description: Homebrew-style evidence-complete report where final validity depends on project boundary policy.
protects: The tool should preserve evidence-complete boundary reports for maintainers rather than deciding project scope itself.

description: Rust-style vague AI-generated language toolchain claim.
protects: AI-generated language/toolchain claims should not reach direct triage without concrete evidence.
